subject: Multiply each row of a matrix by a different scalar

messages.author: 909ff578d0e714f8
messages.subject: Multiply each row of a matrix by a different scalar
parts:
Hi,

I have a vector v (length m) and a matrix A (dim m-by-n). 
I would like to return the matrix whose i-th row is v[i] * A[i,]. What's the simplest way?

Thank you!
Asaf

messages.author: 9d7c257e609d0807
messages.subject: Re: [Israel RUG] Multiply each row of a matrix by a different scalar
parts:
Transpose the matrix. Use standard element-wise multiplication, and then transpose back. Should do the job

t(t(A)*v)
